sector_notes: Friday October 30 produced a broad risk-off session: the Nasdaq fell 2.86% and the S&P 500 1.82% as AI-spending and technology earnings concerns intensified, with technology and communication services leading the weakness. Energy was a relative bright spot after Exxon and Chevron beat profit expectations, while financials, healthcare, consumer defensives and selected industrials provide more resilient diversification. The preferred stance is selective momentum rather than aggressive technology exposure, with extra caution around semiconductor and software names after the October selloff.
